name: Reconstruct shapes
description: Detects monotonic-color regions and fits editable geometry in one tool. Detected masks remain visible and editable, and fitting can be rerun from modified masks without repeating background detection.

stages.name: Detect regions
stages.description: Creates connected, color-aware region masks from the text-erased image and confirmed background.

stages.name: Fit shapes
stages.description: Fits standard primitives or additive rectangle unions to the current region masks.

stages.name: Edit masks and refit
stages.description: Lets the user correct mask membership and rerun fitting against corrected masks.

fields.name: segmentation_method
fields.description: Selects connected-background segmentation, dominant-color plateau splitting, or automatic dispatch between them.

options.name: Auto
options.description: Uses simple connected components and enables plateau splitting only for ambiguous multimodal regions.

options.name: Connected components
options.description: Segments pixels by distance from the confirmed background and separates connected foreground components.

options.name: Dominant-color plateaus
options.description: Discovers locally monotonic color planes and splits touching differently colored shapes.

fields.name: background_tolerance
fields.description: Sets the minimum RGB distance from the confirmed background required for a pixel to count as foreground.

fields.name: minimum_region_area
fields.description: Rejects connected regions smaller than this pixel area as noise.

fields.name: plateau_color_tolerance
fields.description: Controls how close pixels must be in RGB space to form one monotonic color plateau.

fields.name: minimum_plateau_fraction
fields.description: Requires the largest discovered plateau to cover this fraction of an ambiguous region before it may be split, reducing photographic false positives.

fields.name: fit_mode
fields.description: Controls additive reconstruction. Off restricts fitting to standard primitives; On permits additive fitting; Auto tries a simple primitive first and dispatches to additive reconstruction when quality is insufficient.

options.name: Auto
options.description: Uses the simplest adequate primitive and escalates complex regions to additive reconstruction.

options.name: Standard only
options.description: Fits rectangles, rounded rectangles, circles, or ellipses without additive decomposition.

options.name: Additive enabled
options.description: Allows complex regions to be reconstructed as overlapping inscribed rectangles.

fields.name: maximum_pieces
fields.description: Limits how many additive rectangle pieces may be accepted for one region before fitting stops.

fields.name: minimum_piece_area
fields.description: Stops additive decomposition when the next largest unexplained inscribed rectangle is smaller than this area.

fields.name: fit_outer_corners
fields.description: Fits radii for eligible outer corners after additive pieces are assembled. Structural notch corners are not rounded merely because they lie on the union boundary.

fields.name: simple_fit_quality_threshold
fields.description: Defines the minimum accepted quality for a standard primitive before Auto mode considers additive reconstruction.

fields.name: selected_region
fields.description: References the active detected region whose mask and fitted geometry are displayed for inspection or editing.

fields.name: mask_edit_mode
fields.description: Chooses how canvas interaction changes the selected region mask. Mask edits change fitting input but do not directly edit fitted geometry.

options.name: Inspect
options.description: Selects and inspects regions without changing mask pixels.

options.name: Add to mask
options.description: Paints or selects pixels that should belong to the active region.

options.name: Erase from mask
options.description: Removes painted or selected pixels from the active region.

options.name: Merge regions
options.description: Combines selected region masks into one fitting input.

options.name: Split region
options.description: Divides one mask into separate region proposals using a user-defined boundary.

fields.name: mask_brush_size_px
fields.description: Sets the diameter of the add or erase brush in source-image pixels.

fields.name: diagnostic_view
fields.description: Controls the non-mutating canvas view. Selected Mask shows the exact editable pixels supplied to shape fitting.

options.name: Text-erased image
options.description: Shows the raster image supplied to reconstruction.

options.name: Foreground mask
options.description: Shows all pixels classified as non-background.

options.name: Region masks
options.description: Shows each detected region mask with a distinct display color.

options.name: Selected mask
options.description: Shows the exact editable mask for the active region.

options.name: Fitted shapes
options.description: Shows fitted geometry without mask pixels.

options.name: Mask + fit
options.description: Overlays fitted geometry on the active mask so fitting errors are visible.

options.name: Fit residual
options.description: Highlights uncovered mask pixels and shape overclaim.

options.name: Additive steps
options.description: Shows ordered rectangle pieces and the unexplained mask at every additive iteration.

fields.name: preserve_intermediate_steps
fields.description: Stores detected masks, user mask edits, additive steps, residuals, pre-rounding geometry, and final fits as separate recoverable states.

actions.name: Detect and fit shapes
actions.description: Runs region detection from the confirmed background and then fits geometry to every eligible detected mask.

actions.name: Rerun region detection
actions.description: Regenerates automatic masks from the image and segmentation settings while retaining manual mask history.

actions.name: Apply mask edit
actions.description: Creates a new selected-mask version from paint, erase, merge, or split operations and marks that region fit as stale.

actions.name: Rerun shape fitting
actions.description: Fits geometry to current masks, including manual corrections, without repeating background estimation or automatic region detection.

actions.name: Restore automatic mask
actions.description: Restores the original automatically detected mask as a new editable mask version.

invalidation.name: mask_change
invalidation.description: A mask edit invalidates only the fit derived from that region; other region fits remain valid.

invalidation.name: segmentation_change
invalidation.description: Changing segmentation settings invalidates automatic masks and every fit derived from them.

invalidation.name: fitting_change
invalidation.description: Changing fitting settings invalidates fitted geometry while preserving current automatic or edited masks.

output.name: shape_reconstruction_proposals
output.description: Returns versioned masks, mask edits, fill estimates, boxes, fitted geometry, additive pieces, residuals, confidence, IoU, overclaim, and uncovered pixels.
